title: Stream transcript (invalid): SESSION_INIT with malformed payload length
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with a SESSION_INIT entry whose payload is 5 bytes instead of the required 18 bytes (16-byte UUID + 2-byte flags). Must be rejected with SAR_ERR_INVALID_LENGTH.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
SESSION_INIT payload must be exactly 18 bytes: 16-byte UUID + 2-byte flags LE.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
